notes:
Daily accountability reports to a contact you choose; cover a window while you ask for time

During sessions Kairos records what's in front and for how long. At end of day (9 PM by default)
the AI infers what you actually worked on from that activity and your stated focus, and the report
(time locked in, the task, where the time went) is emailed or posted to a Discord, Slack or ntfy
webhook. It goes every day, sessions or not, catching up after the computer was off. The contact
can't be changed during a locked session, and an old contact is told when they're replaced.

Also: the window you're asking for time on is covered until approved, and the mascot is called
off when the tab or app it was heading for is already gone.
